headline: bfloat8_b weights/inputs are essentially lossless (PCC>=0.9998) on EVERY matmul AND SDPA site, and are as-fast-or-faster than bf16. Two SDPA levers CONFIRMED: (1) the flash-SDPA fp32_dest_acc=True kernel bug is real and DRAMATIC on the CLIP flash-SDPA (PCC 0.99996 -> 0.895, and it is also SLOWER) -> keep fp32_dest_acc=False on the vision flash-SDPA; (2) the big SAM-global win is EXPLICIT MATCHED chunking q=k=256 (4.40ms->1.70ms, -61%, AND higher PCC 0.99979->0.99997); exp_approx_mode is numerically/temporally INERT as an isolated lever here. lm_head is bf8-PCC-0.999-safe and 1.7x faster (843us->492us) but keep bf16 for exact-argmax tie-safety on bbox tokens. The MoE router gate does NOT need fp32 for PCC (bf16 == fp32 at ~0.999996) and bf16 is ~12% faster; fp32 is conservative (top-k index match not directly measured).

fp32_dest_acc_bug_CONFIRMED.note: fp32_dest_acc=True on ttnn.transformer.scaled_dot_product_attention REGRESSES CLIP PCC to ~0.90 (all fidelities) AND is slower. On the single-op SAM window/global shapes the fp32=True effect is mild (compounding across 12+ blocks is what hurts). Keep fp32_dest_acc=False on the vision flash-SDPA. NOTE the OPPOSITE holds for LM prefill SDPA: fp32=True HELPS (0.99990->0.99994), no bug there.

q_k_512.status: error:RuntimeError (unsupported at seq 4096 on this grid)

sam_global_chunking_CONFIRMED.exp_approx_isolated: at q=k=256: exp_approx True 0.999970/1696061ns vs False 0.999969/1697953ns -> INERT. The real win is explicit matched chunking (q==k==256), NOT exp_approx. This refines the model docstring's earlier 'exp_approx=False helped' (that gain was the chunking).

sdpa_findings.bf8_qkv_safe: bfloat8_b Q/K/V inputs clear PCC>=0.999 on every site at HiFi2+ (clip 0.99992, window 0.99931, global 0.99987, lm 0.99988) and are marginally faster (global bf8 4.215ms vs bf16 4.403ms).

lm_head_bf8_safe.verdict: bf8 lm_head clears PCC>=0.999 and is 1.7x faster (843us->492us). Residual risk: maxdiff ~0.28-0.52 can flip exact argmax on sub-ULP-tie bbox coordinate tokens -> keep bf16 if exact-argmax tie-safety is required; otherwise bf8 is a real win. L1 output memcfg is MUCH SLOWER for the 1280x129280 matmul (1.89ms vs 843us) -> keep DRAM output.

moe_gate_fp32_not_needed.verdict: fp32 is NOT required for router-logit PCC: bf16 matches fp32 (~0.999996) and is ~12% faster (119us vs 133us); bf8 is 0.99999. CAVEAT: routing is argmax/top-k; the exact top-k index match was not directly measured, but logit PCC ~1.0 makes selection flips very unlikely. fp32 is conservative; bf16 is PCC-equivalent and cheaper.

rel_pos_best.verdict: bf8 (or bf16) are effectively lossless (>=0.9999) on the static-weight rel-pos bmms; HiFi4/fp32 have negligible effect (pure matmul). bf4 still clears 0.99 (~0.9992) and is fastest but carries real error. Recommend bf8.

matmul_extra_findings.clip_fc1_memcfg: L1 output memcfg is FASTER for clip_fc1 (bf8/HiFi2/L1 38950ns @0.99990) than the DRAM sweep's best (bf4/LoFi/DRAM 47589ns). Small win; contrast with lm_head where L1 is much slower.

recommendation.vision_matmuls: bfloat8_b weights (fidelity per op; fp32_dest_acc only where it helped and NOT on the vision flash-SDPA per the confirmed kernel bug) -- lossless.
recommendation.vision_sdpa: Keep fp32_dest_acc=False (kernel bug). For SAM global, use an explicit SDPAProgramConfig with q_chunk_size==k_chunk_size==256 (the -61% device-time + higher-PCC lever; already in the model). exp_approx_mode is inert -- setting it False is harmless but not the source of the gain. bf8 Q/K/V is safe if a further small saving is wanted.
recommendation.lm_head: bf8 is PCC-0.999-safe and 1.7x faster; keep the committed bf16 only for exact bbox-token argmax tie-safety. DRAM output (not L1).
recommendation.moe_gate: bf16 is PCC-equivalent to the committed fp32 and ~12% faster; fp32 is conservative. If routing tie-safety is a concern keep fp32, else bf16 is a safe cost cut.
recommendation.next: config-optimize may (a) add explicit q=k=256 chunking to SAM-global SDPA [already present], (b) optionally move lm_head/MoE-gate to bf8/bf16 if argmax/routing tie-safety validated end-to-end, then re-validate full-model PCC + semantic output.

matmul_progcfg_findings.scope: Explicit MatmulProgramConfig axis the comprehensive op-sweep left on ttnn-AUTO. 8 hot matmuls x {AUTO + 2-4 valid MatmulMultiCoreReuseMultiCast(2D) + 1D(mcast_in0) for tall/skinny + DRAM-sharded for big-N}. Dtype/fidelity held at committed value (bf8_b/HiFi4, lm_head=bf16). PCC sanity only.
matmul_progcfg_findings.coverage: 21 valid explicit configs measured across 8 ops; 3 skipped-invalid (lm_head 1d_8x4 program exception + lm_head DRAM-sharded single-shot N=129280 exceeds L1 width-shard -> needs tt_transformers-style column split; clip_fc1 DRAM-sharded requires M==1 but clip_fc1 M=257 prefill). DRAM-sharded matmul is a DECODE (M==1) construct: only lm_gate (M=8->Mt=1) was eligible+valid, and it was SLOWER than AUTO/1D.
matmul_progcfg_findings.headline: ttnn-AUTO is already optimal for the HEAVY vision-prefill per-block matmuls (clip_qkv, clip_fc1, sam_qkv, sam_lin1) -- every explicit 2D config was SLOWER than AUTO. Explicit program configs beat AUTO only on the small LM/projector matmuls: projector 2d_8x8 63564->28352ns (2.24x, -55.4%), lm_qproj 1d_8x4 20367->11940ns (1.71x, -41.4%), lm_gate 1d_8x4 33915->31383ns (1.08x, -7.5%). The task-highlighted lm_head DRAM-sharded / clip_fc1 / sam_lin1 do NOT beat AUTO here (lm_head DRAM-sharded is infeasible single-shot; clip_fc1/sam_lin1 AUTO optimal).
matmul_progcfg_findings.prefill_matmul_reduction: Among vision-PREFILL matmuls only the projector (single invocation) has an explicit win: -35212 ns (63564->28352). The per-block clip/sam matmuls are AUTO-optimal (0 change). Net single-forward vision-prefill matmul saving from program-config = ~35us (projector), negligible vs the ~10.7s prefill. The larger wins (lm_qproj -8427ns/call, lm_gate -2532ns/call) are per-LM-layer decode ops; total generation saving depends on layer count x decode steps (not projected here -- would require call counts).
matmul_progcfg_findings.pcc_sanity: All explicit winners hold PCC ~identical to AUTO: projector 0.999956 vs auto 0.999953; lm_qproj 0.999977 vs 0.999981; lm_gate 0.999958 vs 0.999963. Confirms program config is numerically inert (device-time-only lever).
